author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: चञ्चलत्वादित्यत्र कस्येति शङ्कां निरस्यन्मनोनिग्रहेणास्तु योगस्य स्थिरतेति शङ्कां निराह॥  चञ्चलमिति ।  मनश्चञ्चलं हि प्रसिद्धम् ।  प्रमाथि प्रमधनशीलं देहेन्द्रियक्षोभकरं किञ्च बलवत् ।  विवेकेनापि जेतुमशक्यं ।  दृढम् ।  विषयवासनानुविद्धतया दुर्भेदं साधुविषये नेतुमशक्यम् ।  अत आकाशे दोधूयमानस्य वायोः वस्त्रेण कुंभादिना वा निरोधनमशक्यं यथा तथा तस्य मनसो निग्रहं निरोधनं दुश्करमहं मन्ये जानामि ॥ ६.३४ ॥
translation:
Restless indeed is the mind, O Krislina; it is rebellious, strong, and unshaken (incorrigible); I think its control is very difficult as of the wind. (34.)
It is rebellious: it throws the body and the organs into great agitation; strong: difficult to subdue by reasoning, and incorrigible for anything that is good. As the blasts of wind cannot be restrained by throwing anything in its way; likewise, it is impossible to obtain perfect control over the mind. (34)
A. Admitting the fickleness or restlessness of the mind, &c, the Lord states the method of making that conquest.
